name: forgeos-brain-console
description: ForgeOS Brain Console — web UI over the isolated gbrain (C:\ForgeOS). The SPA (src/app.js) is served directly by server.ts with NO build step (bun build EPERMs on C:\ in this environment). Edit src/app.js (or src/app.ts, kept in sync) directly; index.html loads /src/app.js as an ES module.
